entities.name: NATO Membership & Security Transformation

entities.summary: Russia's invasion of Ukraine prompting Sweden's historic NATO application (2022), the Turkish and Hungarian ratification delays, and Sweden's accession as NATO's 32nd member (7 March 2024), ending over 200 years of military non-alignment.
